commands_run: $snap = "...snapshots\branch-customer-discovery"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $snap | Out-Null; Copy-Item customer-discovery-findings.md,customer-discovery-data.json -Destination $snap; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force ...receipts | Out-Null; Get-ChildItem $snap
problems_and_friction: No real friction: brief.md was minimal (341 chars), so role mix, incumbent CRM, and budgets had to be assumed and flagged. The no-web constraint means training-cost and learning-curve figures are knowledge-based 2025-era estimates rather than verified data. Parallel-write safety was easy to respect since only role-prefixed files were touched.
context_understood: Read brief.md describing a Salesforce/HubSpot/Zoho CRM evaluation for Brightline (40-person Dublin ad agency) and produced the team-adoption analysis (learning curves, training burden, resistance, change management) as one of three parallel agents, writing only my own two role-prefixed files for a downstream synthesizer.
